privacy.ai_training_note: Tier-dependent. Free, Plus, Pro, and Ultra (individual workspaces): data is used to train Gamma AI features by default; users may opt out at any time via account settings. Per terms of service: 'if your plan does not include privacy controls for AI training or if you do not have such privacy controls for AI training turned on, you agree that Gamma may use your content to train, improve and refine their models, machine learning systems, products and services.' Team and Business workspaces: automatically and permanently excluded from AI training; setting is locked and cannot be changed. Per help center: 'data is automatically excluded from being used for training' and 'Your data will never be used to train Gamma AI features.' Sources: help.gamma.app/en/articles/12281928, gamma.app/terms.
privacy.data_region: United States (Gamma Tech, Inc., San Francisco CA 94114); Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) available via DPA for EU cross-border transfers; no EU data residency option currently available

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS / TLS enforced; help center states: 'All requests and interactions with Gamma are encrypted using HTTPS and secure communication protocols'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256 (self-attested in third-party review sources); trust center controls list 'Data encryption utilized' under Product security

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual external penetration test; trust center Resources lists 'Penetration Test (2025)' as available report

security.name: Infrastructure security controls
security.value: Trust center lists: 'Unique production database authentication enforced', 'Encryption key access restricted', 'Unique account authentication enforced', plus 17 additional infrastructure security controls

security.name: Business continuity
security.value: Trust center lists: 'Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans established', 'Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans tested', 'Cybersecurity insurance maintained'

security.name: SSO / Authentication
security.value: Single Sign-On (SSO) available on Business plan; supports Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, and OneLogin; not available on Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra, or Team plans

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Trust center states: 'Customer data deleted upon leaving'; permanent account deletion removes all content and data

security.name: Sub-processors
security.value: Sub-processor list published at gamma.app/subprocessors; AI inference sub-processors include OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Trust center states: 'Data retention procedures established'; 'Data classification policy established'

products.name: Gamma Free
products.data_scope: User-generated content (presentations, websites, documents, graphics); usage analytics; 400 non-renewing AI credits
products.notes: AI training enabled by default; opt-out available via account settings. No SSO. No DPA. No SOC 2 documentation access.

products.name: Gamma Plus / Pro / Ultra
products.category: AI presentation and content creation (individual, paid)
products.data_scope: User-generated content plus analytics; custom branding and domain features on Pro/Ultra
products.notes: AI training enabled by default; opt-out available. No SSO. No DPA. API access on Pro tier.

products.name: Gamma Team
products.data_scope: User-generated content plus workspace collaboration data; shared folders
products.notes: AI training excluded and locked (cannot be re-enabled). No SSO. Admin controls and centralized billing included.

products.name: Gamma Business
products.data_scope: User-generated content plus workspace collaboration data; governed by DPA on request
products.notes: AI training excluded and locked. SSO available. SOC 2 Type II report available on request (under NDA). DPA available. Minimum 10 seats at $480/seat/yr.

products.name: Gamma API
products.category: Programmatic AI content creation (developer / B2B integration)
products.data_scope: Content submitted programmatically via API; governed by developer/API terms
products.notes: Available on Pro plan and above. AI training terms follow the underlying workspace plan or API contract.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Free ($0), Plus (~$8-9/seat/mo billed annually), Pro (~$15-18/seat/mo), Ultra (~$90/seat/mo), Team ($240/seat/yr, 2-seat min), Business ($480/seat/yr, 10-seat min); 100+ seat custom enterprise contracts available
compare.data_residency: US only; SCCs for EU cross-border transfers via DPA; no EU region selection available

flags: AI TRAINING SPLIT: Free, Plus, Pro, and Ultra individual plans train on customer content by default -- opt-out is available but not the default. Team and Business workspaces never train (locked setting). Organizations on paid individual plans must actively opt out.
SOC 2 REPORT GATED: SOC 2 Type II report (2025) is available only upon request to Business and enterprise prospects -- not publicly downloadable. Free and individual plan users cannot access it.
NO HIPAA: DPA prohibits PHI. No Business Associate Agreement offered. Not suitable for healthcare or regulated health data workloads.
Gamma Tech, Inc. (gamma.app) does not hold ISO 27001. The unrelated UK company Gamma Communications plc (gammagroup.co) does hold ISO 27001; these are different entities.
US DATA ONLY: All data processed in the United States. No EU data residency option. EU customers rely on SCCs in the DPA for lawful cross-border transfers.
NO FEDRAMP / NO CSA STAR / NO ISO 42001: No evidence of FedRAMP, CSA STAR, or ISO/IEC 42001 on any vendor-domain page.
Third-party marketing sites sometimes attribute the SOC 2 or ISO certifications of Gamma Communications plc (the UK telecom) to Gamma Tech, Inc. (the AI tool).

ENTERPRISE TIER: For 100+ seat deployments, Gamma moves to custom enterprise contracts; additional security commitments (audit logs, dedicated CSM, SLAs) may be negotiable but are not publicly documented.
